# Hayalows Skills

> A library of agent skills in the open Agent Skills layout. Each skill is a folder with a SKILL.md entrypoint and optional references, scripts and assets. Start with Master Craft, which selects and sequences the others. Product Design OS is the self-contained UI and UX skill.

This is a curated entrypoint, not the complete live registry. For the full current catalogue, run node master-craft/scripts/catalogue.mjs --latest or enumerate the current pinned Git tree. AI Ops Team and Luna Astra Behaviour are explicit-only.

Read a skill entrypoint first, then only the references it points to for the task. Relative links inside a skill resolve against that skill folder. A skill is instructions only: it grants no tools and no permission.

## Start here

- [master-craft](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/master-craft/SKILL.md): Master Craft is the one-call Hayalows skill orchestrator.
- [product-design-os](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/product-design-os/SKILL.md): Design, redesign, audit, specify or build the UI and UX of a digital product: websites, web apps, mobile apps, dashboards, forms, onboarding, checkout, search, pricing pages, design systems and components.
- [springboard-mentor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/springboard-mentor/SKILL.md): Mentor reply, policy, outreach, REACH, follow-up and documentation workflow; use Papa Kojo Writing Style v3.0 for voice.
- [personal-craft](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/personal-craft/SKILL.md): Apply Papa Kojo's Luna-first working agreement to substantial coding, debugging, architecture, product design, research, data, documents, and automation.
- [Using these skills from any model or agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/master-craft/references/portability.md): Install paths, URL-only use, pasted bundles and API use.
- [Building a product that holds up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/master-craft/references/product-build.md): The staged pipeline for sites, apps and tools.

## Skills

- [agent-team-architect](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/agent-team-architect/SKILL.md): Build, audit and test multi-agent workflows, role contracts, handoffs, repair loops and approval gates.
- [ai-ops-team](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/ai-ops-team/SKILL.md): Explicit invocation only. 4-agent AI Ops Team (Lead, Scout, Scribe, Checker) wired as a Google ADK 2.x graph with parallel research, 2-round quality loop, and human approval.

- [interface-workshop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/interface-workshop/SKILL.md): Build and practise responsive interface design through real tasks.
- [engineering-workshop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/engineering-workshop/SKILL.md): Build, debug and verify software through working examples.

- [behavioral-interaction-design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/behavioral-interaction-design/SKILL.md): Design or audit ethical product interactions that help people start, make progress, enjoy a task, or return for a goal they chose.
- [consulting-grade-reports-decks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/consulting-grade-reports-decks/SKILL.md): Plan and create research-led reports, white papers, analyst reports, SME diagnostics, client deliverables, pitch decks, and decision documents with a premium consulting-style narrative: a clear puzzle, evidence, usefu...
- [create-opportunities](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/create-opportunities/SKILL.md): Turn career, freelance, business, creative, and learning goals into evidence-backed opportunities through useful work.
- [design-taste-frontend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/design-taste-frontend/SKILL.md): Design and refine landing pages, portfolios, editorial sites and marketing websites with intentional composition, truthful content and careful frontend execution.
- [frontend-design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/frontend-design/SKILL.md): Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one.
- [gemini-frontend-design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/gemini-frontend-design/SKILL.md): Google Gemini's original frontend design skill for polished websites and web apps, covering layout, color, typography, imagery, and motion (Apache-2.0).
- [human-copywriting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/human-copywriting/SKILL.md): Write, rewrite, diagnose, and structure natural human-sounding copy, posts, scripts, messages, applications, and essays using clear thinking, concrete detail, audience-aware structure, and ethical persuasion.
- [humanize-my-writing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/humanize-my-writing/SKILL.md): Write, diagnose, rewrite, or polish prose so it sounds natural, specific, and recognizably like Papa Kojo Mensah (Iconka).
- [luna-astra-behavior](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/luna-astra-behavior/SKILL.md): Apply a disciplined evidence, execution and self-review workflow when explicitly asked for Luna-to-Astra behavior or higher-judgment handling of a difficult task.
- [lunour-brand-strategy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/lunour-brand-strategy/SKILL.md): End-to-end brand strategy and identity guidance for companies, products, and founders.
- [lunour-naming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/lunour-naming/SKILL.md): Strategy-led naming for companies, products, services, features, and renames.
- [model-assurance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/model-assurance/SKILL.md): Build, challenge, or validate decision models, financial spreadsheets, forecasts, simulations, and quantitative comparisons when formulas, assumptions, uncertainty, or backtests could change a decision.
- [papa-kojo-writing-style](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/papa-kojo-writing-style/SKILL.md): v3.0 "Original". Write, rewrite, humanise or check anything Papa Kojo Mensah (Iconka) sends as himself, in his own voice. His own words first, a register dial, say-it-first drafting and blind-tested fix recipes.
- [premium-editorial-report-pdf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/premium-editorial-report-pdf/SKILL.md): Create polished, evidence-led editorial reports and professional presentation decks with strong serif headlines, clear sans-serif text, generous whitespace, restrained colour, meaningful photography, and readable data...
- [product-evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/product-evidence/SKILL.md): Plan or assess evidence for a product decision using task-based usability benchmarks, instrumentation checks, controlled experiments, or staged rollout criteria.
- [security-audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/security-audit/SKILL.md): Security guidance and vulnerability review for codebases, APIs, services, CLI tools, libraries, and daemons.
- [thoughtful-cold-email](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/thoughtful-cold-email/SKILL.md): Research, plan, write, critique, personalize, and improve honest cold emails and outreach sequences for sales, freelance services, partnerships, jobs, media, research, introductions, and other goals.
- [ui-ux-craft](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/ui-ux-craft/SKILL.md): Evidence-weighted UI and UX craft for designing, reviewing, or rebuilding digital products.
- [vercel-deployment-steward](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/vercel-deployment-steward/SKILL.md): Use before releasing, pushing, previewing, or debugging Vercel projects.
- [website-ux-audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/website-ux-audit/SKILL.md): Audit a live website, prototype, or code-backed web experience for task success, clarity, accessibility, responsive behaviour, performance, trust, and end-to-end user flow.

## Optional

- [Agent instructions for this repository](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hayalows/Skills/main/AGENTS.md): Rules for agents that edit the library.
